en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Qasim Bin Yahya, from his grandfather Al Hassan Bin Rashid, from Yaqoub Bin Ja’far who said,

‘I heard Abu Al-Hassan<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Upon each nostril of the animal is a Satan<sup>la</sup>. So whenever one of you to bridle it, so he should Name Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic’.
en.sarwar: 13. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Qasim ibn Yahya from his grandfather al-Hassan ibn Rashid from Ya’qub ibn Ja’far who has said the following: “I once heard abu al-Hassan, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ’
In the nostrils of every stumper there is a Satan. When you want to harness them you must say, “In the name of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious.”’”
